Description:

merged master without intentional page rasterization or image downsampling.
Optional Ghostscript rewrites an email candidate with the fixed screen default
or ebook preset. Only a validated candidate smaller than the master is published.
Sources and existing outputs are never replaced. No application network calls,
downloads, telemetry, recursion or OCR are performed.

    ng>] [<CommonParameters>]
    
    
DESCRIPTION
    Orders inputs naturally by filename and uses local PDFtk to publish a validated
    merged master without intentional page rasterization or image downsampling.
    Optional Ghostscript rewrites an email candidate with the fixed screen default
    or ebook preset. Only a validated candidate smaller than the master is published.
    Sources and existing outputs are never replaced. No application network calls,
    downloads, telemetry, recursion or OCR are performed.
    

PARAMETERS
    -SourceFolder <String>
        One existing filesystem directory containing visible top-level PDFs. This is the
        only positional argument. Hidden files and subfolders are not scanned.
        
        Required?                    false
        Position?                    1
        Default value                
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -OutputFolder <String>
        An existing writable directory separate from SourceFolder. The default is the
        entry script's directory. Unsupported reparse paths are refused with guidance.
        
        Required?                    false
        Position?                    named
        Default value                
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -SkipEmail [<SwitchParameter>]
        Publishes only the validated master and bypasses Ghostscript discovery and use.
        An explicitly supplied EmailPreset is reported as ignored.
        
        Required?                    false
        Position?                    named
        Default value                False
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -EmailPreset <String>
        Selects the fixed screen or ebook Ghostscript preset; screen is the default.
        The email copy can lose detail. Inspect it before sharing; no target size is promised.
        
        Required?                    false
        Position?                    named
        Default value                screen
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    <CommonParameters>
        This cmdlet supports the common parameters: Verbose, Debug,
        ErrorAction, ErrorVariable, WarningAction, WarningVariable,
        OutBuffer, PipelineVariable, and OutVariable. For more information, see 
        about_CommonParameters (https:/go.microsoft.com/fwlink/?LinkID=113216). 
    
INPUTS
    
OUTPUTS
    
NOTES
    
    
        Requires Windows PowerShell 5.1 or a separately validated PowerShell 7 build,
        PDFtk Server, and optional Ghostscript. Processing stays local. Diagnostic logs
        are UTF-8 and can contain document names, full paths and native PDF metadata;
        they are not redacted or encrypted. Sanitize a copy before sharing a public report.
        Missing input exits 1. A validated master with skipped/unavailable/no-size-benefit
        email exits 0; email failure after master publication exits 2 and retains the master.
        Binding, source or destination failures may occur before a safe log is available.
        Neither output guarantees PDF/A, signature validity, universal feature retention,
        archival certification or malware removal. Keep original documents.
    
    -------------------------- EXAMPLE 1 --------------------------
    
    PS C:\>.\WinPDFMerge.ps1 'C:\Work\Papers\ToMerge'
    
    Writes the master, any smaller validated screen email copy, and log beside the script.
    
    
    
    
    -------------------------- EXAMPLE 2 --------------------------
    
    PS C:\>.\WinPDFMerge.ps1 'C:\Work\Papers\ToMerge' -OutputFolder 'C:\Work\Merged'
    
    Uses the existing separate output directory.
    
    
    
    
    -------------------------- EXAMPLE 3 --------------------------
    
    PS C:\>.\WinPDFMerge.ps1 'C:\Work\Papers\ToMerge' -SkipEmail
    
    Creates the master without discovering or launching Ghostscript.
    
    
    
    
    -------------------------- EXAMPLE 4 --------------------------
    
    PS C:\>.\WinPDFMerge.ps1 'C:\Work\Papers\ToMerge' -EmailPreset ebook
    
    Selects the ebook email preset. A candidate without a size benefit is omitted.

NAME
    <REPO>\tests\.work\diagnostics\276b72e7f066414b8eff703e28391f0b\7961e5165fa9432ea92d6465b307e84a\app with spaces\WinPDFMerge.ps1
    
SYNOPSIS
    Merges the visible top-level PDFs in one folder and optionally creates a smaller email copy.
    
    
SYNTAX
    <REPO>\tests\.work\diagnostics\276b72e7f066414b8eff703e28391f0b\7961e5165fa9432ea92d6465b307e84a\app with spaces\WinPDFMerge.ps1 [[-SourceFolder] <String>] [-OutputFolder <String>] [-SkipEmail] [-EmailPreset <Stri
    ng>] [<CommonParameters>]
    
    
DESCRIPTION
    Orders inputs naturally by filename and uses local PDFtk to publish a validated
    merged master without intentional page rasterization or image downsampling.
    Optional Ghostscript rewrites an email candidate with the fixed screen default
    or ebook preset. Only a validated candidate smaller than the master is published.
    Sources and existing outputs are never replaced. No application network calls,
    downloads, telemetry, recursion or OCR are performed.
    

PARAMETERS
    -SourceFolder <String>
        One existing filesystem directory containing visible top-level PDFs. This is the
        only positional argument. Hidden files and subfolders are not scanned.
        
        Required?                    false
        Position?                    1
        Default value                
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -OutputFolder <String>
        An existing writable directory separate from SourceFolder. The default is the
        entry script's directory. Unsupported reparse paths are refused with guidance.
        
        Required?                    false
        Position?                    named
        Default value                
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -SkipEmail [<SwitchParameter>]
        Publishes only the validated master and bypasses Ghostscript discovery and use.
        An explicitly supplied EmailPreset is reported as ignored.
        
        Required?                    false
        Position?                    named
        Default value                False
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -EmailPreset <String>
        Selects the fixed screen or ebook Ghostscript preset; screen is the default.
        The email copy can lose detail. Inspect it before sharing; no target size is promised.
        
        Required?                    false
        Position?                    named
        Default value                screen
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    <CommonParameters>
        This cmdlet supports the common parameters: Verbose, Debug,
        ErrorAction, ErrorVariable, WarningAction, WarningVariable,
        OutBuffer, PipelineVariable, and OutVariable. For more information, see 
        about_CommonParameters (https:/go.microsoft.com/fwlink/?LinkID=113216). 
    
INPUTS
    
OUTPUTS
    
NOTES
    
    
        Requires Windows PowerShell 5.1 or a separately validated PowerShell 7 build,
        PDFtk Server, and optional Ghostscript. Processing stays local. Diagnostic logs
        are UTF-8 and can contain document names, full paths and native PDF metadata;
        they are not redacted or encrypted. Sanitize a copy before sharing a public report.
        Missing input exits 1. A validated master with skipped/unavailable/no-size-benefit
        email exits 0; email failure after master publication exits 2 and retains the master.
        Binding, source or destination failures may occur before a safe log is available.
        Neither output guarantees PDF/A, signature validity, universal feature retention,
        archival certification or malware removal. Keep original documents.
    
    -------------------------- EXAMPLE 1 --------------------------
    
    PS C:\>.\WinPDFMerge.ps1 'C:\Work\Papers\ToMerge'
    
    Writes the master, any smaller validated screen email copy, and log beside the script.
    
    
    
    
    -------------------------- EXAMPLE 2 --------------------------
    
    PS C:\>.\WinPDFMerge.ps1 'C:\Work\Papers\ToMerge' -OutputFolder 'C:\Work\Merged'
    
    Uses the existing separate output directory.
    
    
    
    
    -------------------------- EXAMPLE 3 --------------------------
    
    PS C:\>.\WinPDFMerge.ps1 'C:\Work\Papers\ToMerge' -SkipEmail
    
    Creates the master without discovering or launching Ghostscript.
    
    
    
    
    -------------------------- EXAMPLE 4 --------------------------
    
    PS C:\>.\WinPDFMerge.ps1 'C:\Work\Papers\ToMerge' -EmailPreset ebook
    
    Selects the ebook email preset. A candidate without a size benefit is omitted.

Help.FullText:
NAME
    <REPO>\tests\.work\diagnostics\276b72e7f066414b8eff703e28391f0b\06850bf90eee44a28935664b0ed5ba1f\app with spaces\WinPDFMerge.ps1
    
SYNOPSIS
    Merges the visible top-level PDFs in one folder and optionally creates a smaller email copy.
    
    
SYNTAX
    <REPO>\tests\.work\diagnostics\276b72e7f066414b8eff703e28391f0b\06850bf90eee44a28935664b0ed5ba1f\app with spaces\WinPDFMerge.ps1 [[-SourceFolder] <String>] [-OutputFolder <String>] [-SkipEmail] [-EmailPreset <Stri
    ng>] [<CommonParameters>]
    
    
DESCRIPTION
    Orders inputs naturally by filename and uses local PDFtk to publish a validated
    merged master without intentional page rasterization or image downsampling.
    Optional Ghostscript rewrites an email candidate with the fixed screen default
    or ebook preset. Only a validated candidate smaller than the master is published.
    Sources and existing outputs are never replaced. No application network calls,
    downloads, telemetry, recursion or OCR are performed.
    

PARAMETERS
    -SourceFolder <String>
        One existing filesystem directory containing visible top-level PDFs. This is the
        only positional argument. Hidden files and subfolders are not scanned.
        
        Required?                    false
        Position?                    1
        Default value                
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -OutputFolder <String>
        An existing writable directory separate from SourceFolder. The default is the
        entry script's directory. Unsupported reparse paths are refused with guidance.
        
        Required?                    false
        Position?                    named
        Default value                
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -SkipEmail [<SwitchParameter>]
        Publishes only the validated master and bypasses Ghostscript discovery and use.
        An explicitly supplied EmailPreset is reported as ignored.
        
        Required?                    false
        Position?                    named
        Default value                False
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -EmailPreset <String>
        Selects the fixed screen or ebook Ghostscript preset; screen is the default.
        The email copy can lose detail. Inspect it before sharing; no target size is promised.
        
        Required?                    false
        Position?                    named
        Default value                screen
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    <CommonParameters>
        This cmdlet supports the common parameters: Verbose, Debug,
        ErrorAction, ErrorVariable, WarningAction, WarningVariable,
        OutBuffer, PipelineVariable, and OutVariable. For more information, see 
        about_CommonParameters (https:/go.microsoft.com/fwlink/?LinkID=113216). 
    
INPUTS
    
OUTPUTS
    
NOTES
    
    
        Requires Windows PowerShell 5.1 or a separately validated PowerShell 7 build,
        PDFtk Server, and optional Ghostscript. Processing stays local. Diagnostic logs
        are UTF-8 and can contain document names, full paths and native PDF metadata;
        they are not redacted or encrypted. Sanitize a copy before sharing a public report.
        Missing input exits 1. A validated master with skipped/unavailable/no-size-benefit
        email exits 0; email failure after master publication exits 2 and retains the master.
        Binding, source or destination failures may occur before a safe log is available.
        Neither output guarantees PDF/A, signature validity, universal feature retention,
        archival certification or malware removal. Keep original documents.
    
    -------------------------- EXAMPLE 1 --------------------------
    
    PS C:\>.\WinPDFMerge.ps1 'C:\Work\Papers\ToMerge'
    
    Writes the master, any smaller validated screen email copy, and log beside the script.
    
    
    
    
    -------------------------- EXAMPLE 2 --------------------------
    
    PS C:\>.\WinPDFMerge.ps1 'C:\Work\Papers\ToMerge' -OutputFolder 'C:\Work\Merged'
    
    Uses the existing separate output directory.
    
    
    
    
    -------------------------- EXAMPLE 3 --------------------------
    
    PS C:\>.\WinPDFMerge.ps1 'C:\Work\Papers\ToMerge' -SkipEmail
    
    Creates the master without discovering or launching Ghostscript.
    
    
    
    
    -------------------------- EXAMPLE 4 --------------------------
    
    PS C:\>.\WinPDFMerge.ps1 'C:\Work\Papers\ToMerge' -EmailPreset ebook
    
    Selects the ebook email preset. A candidate without a size benefit is omitted.

NAME
    <REPO>\tests\.work\diagnostics\276b72e7f066414b8eff703e28391f0b\2a30931666d145a8a65275c539ed768f\app with spaces\WinPDFMerge.ps1
    
SYNOPSIS
    Merges the visible top-level PDFs in one folder and optionally creates a smaller email copy.
    
    
SYNTAX
    <REPO>\tests\.work\diagnostics\276b72e7f066414b8eff703e28391f0b\2a30931666d145a8a65275c539ed768f\app with spaces\WinPDFMerge.ps1 [[-SourceFolder] <String>] [-OutputFolder <String>] [-SkipEmail] [-EmailPreset <Stri
    ng>] [<CommonParameters>]
    
    
DESCRIPTION
    Orders inputs naturally by filename and uses local PDFtk to publish a validated
    merged master without intentional page rasterization or image downsampling.
    Optional Ghostscript rewrites an email candidate with the fixed screen default
    or ebook preset. Only a validated candidate smaller than the master is published.
    Sources and existing outputs are never replaced. No application network calls,
    downloads, telemetry, recursion or OCR are performed.
    

PARAMETERS
    -SourceFolder <String>
        One existing filesystem directory containing visible top-level PDFs. This is the
        only positional argument. Hidden files and subfolders are not scanned.
        
        Required?                    false
        Position?                    1
        Default value                
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -OutputFolder <String>
        An existing writable directory separate from SourceFolder. The default is the
        entry script's directory. Unsupported reparse paths are refused with guidance.
        
        Required?                    false
        Position?                    named
        Default value                
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -SkipEmail [<SwitchParameter>]
        Publishes only the validated master and bypasses Ghostscript discovery and use.
        An explicitly supplied EmailPreset is reported as ignored.
        
        Required?                    false
        Position?                    named
        Default value                False
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    -EmailPreset <String>
        Selects the fixed screen or ebook Ghostscript preset; screen is the default.
        The email copy can lose detail. Inspect it before sharing; no target size is promised.
        
        Required?                    false
        Position?                    named
        Default value                screen
        Accept pipeline input?       false
        Accept wildcard characters?  false
        
    <CommonParameters>
        This cmdlet supports the common parameters: Verbose, Debug,
        ErrorAction, ErrorVariable, WarningAction, WarningVariable,
        OutBuffer, PipelineVariable, and OutVariable. For more information, see 
        about_CommonParameters (https:/go.microsoft.com/fwlink/?LinkID=113216). 
    
INPUTS
    
OUTPUTS
    
NOTES
    
    
        Requires Windows PowerShell 5.1 or a separately validated PowerShell 7 build,
        PDFtk Server, and optional Ghostscript. Processing stays local. Diagnostic logs
        are UTF-8 and can contain document names, full paths and native PDF metadata;
        they are not redacted or encrypted. Sanitize a copy before sharing a public report.
        Missing input exits 1. A validated master with skipped/unavailable/no-size-benefit
        email exits 0; email failure after master publication exits 2 and retains the master.
        Binding, source or destination failures may occur before a safe log is available.
        Neither output guarantees PDF/A, signature validity, universal feature retention,
        archival certification or malware removal. Keep original documents.
    
    -------------------------- EXAMPLE 1 --------------------------
    
    PS C:\>.\WinPDFMerge.ps1 'C:\Work\Papers\ToMerge'
    
    Writes the master, any smaller validated screen email copy, and log beside the script.
    
    
    
    
    -------------------------- EXAMPLE 2 --------------------------
    
    PS C:\>.\WinPDFMerge.ps1 'C:\Work\Papers\ToMerge' -OutputFolder 'C:\Work\Merged'
    
    Uses the existing separate output directory.
    
    
    
    
    -------------------------- EXAMPLE 3 --------------------------
    
    PS C:\>.\WinPDFMerge.ps1 'C:\Work\Papers\ToMerge' -SkipEmail
    
    Creates the master without discovering or launching Ghostscript.
    
    
    
    
    -------------------------- EXAMPLE 4 --------------------------
    
    PS C:\>.\WinPDFMerge.ps1 'C:\Work\Papers\ToMerge' -EmailPreset ebook
    
    Selects the ebook email preset. A candidate without a size benefit is omitted.
